test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 14 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six letters A, B, C, D, E and F are written on different faces of a dice. Two different positions of this dice are shown in the figure. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the one having E. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bb2c033abfaffc9efd8fa0a3288cda79df17554e025138ff638840b6be7b568.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As D is common on both the dice, it is clear that B, F, C, and A are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e., E will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20a038461c46e4d959a609a1ae4b83f9412180b80863402ff2bab44fbdb8f9be.png] 

Opposite pairs:

F → C

B → A

D → E

So, the opposite side of "E" will be side "D".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
